title: Zotdex published data
description: The file dist/v1/plugins.json that pnpm build writes: one record for each entry under plugins/.

generatedAt.description: When the build started, as a UTC time such as 2026-10-25T06:17:00.000Z.

zoteroRelease.description: The current Zotero release that zotero.org gave when the build ran, such as 10.0.7. Absent when the build could not read it.

plugins.description: One record for each entry, sorted by id.

id.description: The entry directory name. pnpm check requires it to equal the id in the entry's meta.json; the build does not check it.

repoUrl.description: The repoUrl of the entry's meta.json.

paidService.description: Set when a maintainer read that the plugin's main use stops without paying its maker, or stops after a trial. A lasting free plan with a paid upgrade, a plugin that also works with a third party's key, and a donation do not count.

note.description: What the plugin needs to be paid for, in English.

read.description: The date the maintainer read that page, as YYYY-MM-DD.

upstream.description: The facts read from the plugin's GitHub repo, its releases, and its release XPI, after a check that its update.json lists the plugin id. Present when the read succeeds, and on a kept record, where these facts come from an earlier build (see kept).

reports.description: The counted user reports on the plugin version in upstream: one item for each Zotero major with at least one counted report, ordered by major. A report is a closed issue of the index repo with the label report; "Using the data" in https://github.com/jmgirard/zotdex/blob/main/docs/data.md gives the counting rule. Present on each record with upstream since the build counts reports.

startTests.description: Whether the plugin version in upstream started in each tested Zotero release that its manifest's strict_min_version and strict_max_version cover, without overrides: one item for each such release that gave a result, ordered by Zotero version. The build starts the plugin in a new profile of Zotero for Linux and waits 3 seconds after the install. It starts it again for an XPI whose SHA-256 differs from the one last tested, for a tested release with no earlier result, after a result other than started, and on the entry's re-test day, once every 7 days, in a build that deploys, and whenever the build cannot read the published data; otherwise it keeps the last started result. It reuses no result of a kept record, and a kept record keeps the start results published with its facts. A start does not show that the plugin works. Absent when no tested release gave a result, and in data written before the start tests.

kept.description: Present when this build's read of the plugin failed for a reason that usually points at the build or a host, such as not-read, a timeout, or an HTTP 5xx answer, and the record holds the upstream and startTests of the record that an earlier build published. The build keeps them for at most 7 days after readAt. Absent in data written before the build kept facts.

readAt.description: When the build that read these facts started, as generatedAt gives it.

failure.description: Why this build could not read the plugin, as failure gives it on a record with no kept facts.
Why the upstream read failed, or why the build did not read the plugin. Present when the read fails or does not run, in place of upstream, unless the record keeps earlier facts, when kept holds it.

name.description: A failure name of the reader, such as fork or no-xpi-release; unexpected-error for an error the reader does not name; facts-invalid for facts that this schema rejects; or not-read for an entry that the build did not read before its time limit.

overrides.description: The overrides of the entry's index.json, unchanged. The upstream block does not apply them.

name.description: The manifest name, with a __MSG_ name resolved from the first of _locales/en/, _locales/en_US/, and _locales/en_GB/ whose message is a string that is not blank, else from the default locale.

description.description: The manifest description, with a __MSG_ name resolved as for name. The site shows a description override that applies to the version read; without one, it shows this description or the repoDescription, by the rule in https://github.com/jmgirard/zotdex/blob/main/docs/site.md.

repoUrl.description: The repo URL that GitHub returns.

repoDescription.description: The repo's About text that GitHub returns, with outer whitespace trimmed. Absent when GitHub gives none, a value that is not a string, or a blank one, and in data written before the build wrote it.

openIssues.description: Open issues and pull requests in the repo.

stars.description: The repo's star count that GitHub returns. Absent when GitHub gives no integer of at least 0, and in data written before the build wrote it.

releaseCount.description: Releases that carry an .xpi asset, drafts excluded.

latestReleaseDate.description: The publish date of the release whose manifest was read.

xpiUrl.description: The browser_download_url that GitHub gives for the first .xpi asset of the release whose manifest was read: the author's own file, of which the index keeps no copy. The author can replace the file at this address later. Absent in data written before the build wrote it.

xpiSha256.description: The SHA-256 of the bytes that the build read from xpiUrl, in lowercase hexadecimal. A file downloaded later from xpiUrl that has another SHA-256 is not the file the build read and the start tests started. Absent in data written before the build wrote it.

icon.description: The plugin's icon: a 96 by 96 PNG that the build drew from the file that the manifest's icons names, at this path relative to the folder of this data file. Its file name is the SHA-256 of its bytes. Absent when the manifest names no icon, the build cannot read or draw it, it is a stock icon of zotero-plugin-template, a maintainer hid it (iconHidden in index.json), the record keeps earlier facts and the build cannot read the earlier icon file back, and in data written before the build wrote it.

prerelease.description: Whether GitHub marks the release whose manifest was read as a prerelease. The reader reads the newest stable release with an .xpi first, and a prerelease only when no stable release has an .xpi or the stable release is not a Zotero 7+ build.

archived.description: Whether GitHub marks the repo archived. Absent when the GitHub response gives no boolean.

sourceInRepo.description: Whether the top level of the repo's default branch holds a name that can be source code. It comes from names alone: no code and no folder is read, so false can be wrong, and true says nothing about a license or how the XPI was built. Absent when the build could not read the names.

languages.description: The language tags of the locale folders (locale/<tag>/ and chrome/locale/<tag>/) in the XPI whose manifest was read, each with a language other than und, zxx, and mul that has an English name in the build's Node.js Intl data, in canonical form, each once, in code-unit order. A tag's count is the number of messages in the files of its folders: each Fluent message or term line of an .ftl file, each line of a .properties file that is not blank and not a # or ! comment, and each <!ENTITY outside comments in a .dtd file. A tag is listed when its count is at least 1 and at least half the largest count among the XPI's tags. A tag with a file of any other type, or with a file that the reader does not inflate, cannot inflate, or inflates to a length other than its declared size, is listed whatever its count, and such a file adds nothing to any count. Empty when the XPI has no such tag. A listed language can still be incomplete, since a tag with half the fullest tag's messages is listed.

zoteroMajor.description: The Zotero major the reports name, such as 7.

works.description: Counted reports that the plugin works on this major.

broken.description: Counted reports that the plugin is broken on this major.

zotero.description: The Zotero version started, such as 10.0.6.

result.description: started: Zotero listed the plugin as active and logged no startup error within 3 seconds of the install. start-error: the plugin's startup threw or rejected in that time. not-installed: Zotero did not list the plugin, or listed it as inactive. timed-out: no answer came before the start's time limit.

value.description: For languages: one or more language tags joined by ", ", such as "zh-CN, en-US".

field.description: The upstream fact this override corrects or, for an English description or a text that the repository's owner asks for, fills in or replaces: name, description, homepage (homepage_url in the manifest), strict_min_version and strict_max_version, which correct the upstream strictMinVersion and strictMaxVersion, or languages, which names the right upstream languages.

version.description: The plugin version the override applies to. Absent means every version.

reason.description: Why the upstream value is wrong, or, for English description text, its upstream source and which case each upstream description is, as schemas/index.v1.schema.json says. For a text that the repository's owner asks for, the issue that asks.
